fixed_generation_attention.title: Live GitHub pin race · 5 workers

latest_return.summary: Post-claim validation rejected the allocator recovery hint before substantive mutation. This fixture is explicitly generation-1-specific: its mission requires fresh workers to contend on deterministic G000001 and its definition of done counts four G000001 loser collision receipts. A recovery G000002 cannot satisfy that mission and would distort the contention fixture. Generation 2 was reserved atomically but no execution claim, product mutation, collision fabrication or production promotion was performed.

fixed_generation_attention.reason: This contention fixture's mission and acceptance criteria are explicitly bound to deterministic G000001; later generations cannot satisfy it. Keep reconcile attention until the four required loser collision receipts exist, even if an invalid later-generation return projected the job as terminal.

diagnostics.projection_rule: No-PIN launches age out of Ahora quickly; superseded pin generations remain evidence but are not simultaneous active owners. Reconciled route-abort receipts remain historical evidence but do not terminally close jobs.
